blocks.title: SQL
blocks.starterSource:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS revenue
FROM source.orders
WHERE net_amount > 0
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC

blocks.title: SparkLab
blocks.starterSource:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

orders = spark.table("source.orders").filter(F.col("net_amount") > 0)
result = orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(
    F.sum("net_amount").alias("revenue"),
    F.count("order_id").alias("orders")
)

blocks.title: Python
blocks.starterSource:
rows = query("""
SELECT customer_id, net_amount
FROM source.orders
WHERE net_amount > 0
ORDER BY net_amount DESC
""")
display(rows[:8])

blocks.title: Polars
blocks.starterSource:
import polars as pl

orders = pl.DataFrame(query("SELECT * FROM source.orders"))
result = (
    orders
    .filter(pl.col("net_amount") > 0)
    .group_by("customer_id")
    .agg(
        pl.col("net_amount").sum().alias("revenue"),
        pl.len().alias("orders"),
    )
    .sort("revenue", descending=True)
)
display(result)

files.source:
name: datapass_retail
version: '1.0.0'
config-version: 2
profile: datapass_retail
model-paths: [models]
seed-paths: [seeds]
test-paths: [tests]
models:
  datapass_retail:
    staging:
      +materialized: view
    marts:
      +materialized: table

sources:
  db:
    type: dbt_profile
    profile: datapass_retail
    target: dev

-- One row per order; invalid amounts do not contribute.
select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_month,
    cast(net_amount as decimal(18,2)) as revenue
from {{ ref('raw_orders') }}
where net_amount > 0

select
    customer_id as customer_key,
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    city
from {{ ref('raw_customers') }}

-- Grain: one row per valid order.
select
    o.order_id,
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    o.order_month,
    o.revenue
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} as o
left join {{ ref('dim_customers') }} as c
    on o.customer_id = c.customer_id

version: 2
models:
  - name: stg_orders
    description: One row per valid order.
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
  - name: dim_customers
    columns:
      - name: customer_key
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
  - name: fct_sales
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: customer_key
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_customers')
                field: customer_key

-- dbt singular tests return failing rows. Zero rows means pass.
select *
from {{ ref('fct_sales') }}
where revenue <= 0 or revenue is null

mappings.expression: Lookup using the customer business key
